Asset type: transparent pixel-art theme illustration for a polished music app. Create a single wide, low horizontal vignette for the theme CATS & KITTENS: three charming tiny cats (cream, ginger, black) curled beside a wool ball, a small houseplant, and a few paw-print pixels. Sophisticated cozy indie-game pixel art, crisp square pixels, limited palette of warm cream, burnt sienna, dusty rose, sage and deep cocoa. Compose all artwork in a low gently asymmetrical cluster across the bottom half of a 3:1 wide canvas, with generous transparent air above and at both ends. Isolated decoration, no solid ground rectangle or panel. Readable silhouette at small app-header size, subtle dimensional shading, affectionate but not babyish. No text, letters, logos, UI, frames, watermarks, blurry paint or smooth vector edges. Truly transparent background. One cohesive finished asset.
